$comment: Term grammar and the transition relation, transcribed from spec/TERM_LANGUAGE.md and spec/OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS.md. The layout cells of spec/JUDGMENT_LAYER.md section 2d.5 are transcribed under `layout_cells`. Prose wins on disagreement.

_meta.authority: Faithful transcription for mechanization consumers. Where it disagrees with spec/, the prose wins and this file must be fixed.
_meta.precision_note: This file is written to the standard a Lean formalization would consume from: an agent must be able to build the development from this plus state.json without re-deriving the semantics from prose. That standard holds whether or not Lean comes soon, because re-tightening a transcription after an implementation exists costs more than getting it right first.

productions.meaning: Direct sum. Constructs states, NOT a command.
Binary interface gluing of two state expressions along an ordered seam-addition list u.
Hypergraph product of two binary parity-check matrices.
Lifted product over a finite abelian group G.
Two-block group-algebra code over a finite abelian group G.
Concatenation of outer and inner CSS states through chosen inner logical representatives L.
CSS tensor product of two presented CSS states.
Two-sheet duplication of a presented CSS state with wiring w and optional sector swap s.
Balanced product of two binary matrices equivariant under a finite abelian group G.
Quantum Tanner construction from local check matrices and local-to-global embeddings.
Tile or cellulation construction from local tiles T and placements P.
CSS code from two nested classical codes given by binary parity-check matrices.

productions.argument: r carries a chosen sector type
q is a live qubit; tau is X or Z; ordered_row_ids names exactly every tau row touching q
q is a live qubit; tau is X or Z; r names a displayed tau row containing q
Delta is a qubit set disjoint from Q; u is an ordered list of typed (sector, support) additions over Q union Delta

T is a list of distinct qubit labels of Q (a repeated label is malformed: a list with repeats does not name a subset); the transition is admitted for T=Q (the sector exchange) and T=empty (the identity), and is inapplicable otherwise
tau is X or Z; M is an invertible (GL(m,2)) matrix over that sector's displayed rows

productions.order: conventional left-to-right; the second command's applicability is checked against the INTERMEDIATE state, not the original

closed_term.meaning: Evaluate the state expression e, then execute command m against the result.
closed_term.note: e always denotes a state and m denotes a PARTIAL state transformer. The grammar never composes a state with a command as if both were functions.

kernel_is_five.note: The five core primitives remain the kernel. E-GRAFT, the five Gate 6 CSS cells admitted 2026-10-23, and the binary E-GLUE evaluator transition (section 4.30, 2026-10-27) are separately admitted as conditional construction transitions. Other operations outside these productions have NO production and are not encoded as commands over an existing CSS state.

excluded.reason: Presentation operation. A congruence to be PROVED (OBL-PRESENTATION-CONJUGATION), not a command.
Admitted as a conditional extension transition (see admitted_extensions), not one of the kernel five.

Needs typed quotient and embedding inputs; the ten admitted constructors (L-HGP, L-LIFTED, L-GROUP-ALGEBRA, A-CONCAT, L-BALANCED, L-TANNER, L-TILE, A-PRODUCT, A-DOUBLE, L-NESTED-CSS) have expression productions in categories.expression.

E-SPLIT needs separately admitted support/interface predicates. E-GLUE's binary evaluator transition is listed in admitted_extensions (no unary production; contract-index row transition-defined as of 2026-11-11, issue #332). The five Gate 6 cells admitted 2026-10-23 (P-REBASE, E-PEEL, E-PUNCTURE, E-EXTEND, E-LOCAL-HADAMARD) are listed in admitted_extensions.

ambient_space.carrier: F_2^Q, where Q is the state's qubit namespace
ambient_space.statement: X and Z are subspaces of F_2^Q. Every displayed row and every `addStab` argument r is a vector on Q: supp(r) subseteq Q. Complements (Z-perp, X-perp) are taken INSIDE F_2^Q, so `r in Z-perp` presupposes r in F_2^Q.
ambient_space.why_it_is_a_field: Without it the C-ADD-CHECK commutation premise is readable as a bare dot product, which accepts a row whose support leaves Q and yields a display satisfying I1-I5 that is not a code on Q (fixture W22).

relation.name: Eval
relation.partiality: No judgment when a command is inapplicable. No residual commands, no half-updated states, no partial results are ever exposed (W10).
relation.construction: Eval(m >< e, S') when EvalExpr(e, S) and Eval(m, S, S')
relation.derived_denotation: Added 2026-10-25 (issue #140, Option A; OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS.md section 1a): the relation is primary and the denotation is derived from it. denote(m)(S) = some S' iff Eval(m, S, S'), none otherwise; denoteExpr(e) = some S iff EvalExpr(e, S). The 2026-09-30 framework decision's presentation ('Eval defined from the denotation') is superseded on this one point; its disciplines D1 (erasure of steps) and D2 (no consequence, no computation) and its Option carrier remain in force. The Lean development carries denote/denoteExpr with the equivalence theorems (lean/CodeCalculus/Eval.lean).

outcomes.derivable: A derivation exists and the assertion is included.
outcomes.no_derivation: Well-typed term, but no evaluation derivation (inapplicable). ABSENCE OF DERIVATION IS THE BEHAVIOUR, not a failure of it.
outcomes.distinction: malformed, no_derivation and false are THREE different outcomes. A well-typed term naming an undisplayed generator is no_derivation, not malformed and not false.

every row of H_X has even overlap with every row of H_Z, that is H_X H_Z^T = 0 (the nesting of the two classical codes); a failed premise is a no-derivation
every natural row has support in the fresh namespace by construction (W22 reading)

update.rows: the rows of H_X in order as X-rows, then the rows of H_Z in order as Z-rows, each on the columns where it is 1; displayed rows are the retained independent display per sector (section 4.34)

rules.inapplicable_when: Matrices with a row of H_X and a row of H_Z in odd overlap give no derivation; matrices with different column counts, no row, or a non-binary entry are malformed at the encoding.
rules.standing: transition specified 2026-11-13 (issue #445), transition-defined; output well-formed under the nesting premise and k = n - rank(H_X) - rank(H_Z) (section 4.36); no distance rule and no classical distance input; an instance of the L-TANNER rule

layout_cells.$comment: Layout cells (spec/JUDGMENT_LAYER.md section 2d.5, landed 2026-11-10, issue #333): how the layout travels with each transition and the exact interaction-radius and honesty cell it licenses. The radius formulas are also transcribed in consumer.json geometry.carry_rules; this table records the transport side (the child's layout), each cell's direction, its evidence status, and its derivation. `proved` is the evidence status of a dated hand derivation in this repository, never a mechanized result (AGENTS.md, Claim-status discipline). A cell marked conditional needs the named layout premise before its verdict applies.
layout_cells.conformance: machine/experiments/layout_conformance_harness.py randomizes small states and layouts, transits every transition below, and checks each direction, formula, and honesty claim exactly; a run with no violation is evidence, never confirmation.

C-SKIP.honesty: preserved: the layout is unchanged, and honesty is a property of the layout alone

C-DIRECT-SUM.child_layout: the two summand layouts blockwise, up to isometry (not their set-theoretic union, which need not be a layout); a merged layout must be supplied
C-DIRECT-SUM.honesty: not automatic: the merged layout must be honest (conditional cell; merging two honest layouts can place two qubits on one site or two sites closer than 1)

C-DELETE-CHECK.radius: r' = max { diam_lambda(s) : s in rows' }, exact

E-GRAFT.child_layout: lambda restricted to Q \ {q}: the parent's coordinates read at the surviving qubits
E-GRAFT.radius: r' = max { diam_lambda'(s) : s in rows' }, exact (recomputed over the child's own display)
E-GRAFT.direction: may increase; r' <= 2r (the non-increase r' <= r is false: machine/experiments/layout_graft_survey.json records 198 of 823 applicable grafts increasing it)
E-GRAFT.honesty: preserved: a restriction of an honest layout is honest (occupancy can only fall, site spacing can only grow)

C-SEQUENCE.child_layout: transported step by step: the layout after the sequence is the layout after its last step
C-SEQUENCE.honesty: per step; a conditional premise (merged or supplied layout) is owed at the step that needs it

P-REBASE.radius: r' = max { diam_lambda(s) : s in rows' }, exact (the selected sector's supports are symmetric differences of the old supports)
P-REBASE.direction: none guaranteed: both r' > r and r' < r occur

E-LOCAL-HADAMARD.child_layout: lambda, unchanged (T = Q: Q and every support are unchanged; only the sector labels swap)

E-PEEL.child_layout: lambda restricted to Q \ {q}: the parent's coordinates read at the surviving qubits
E-PEEL.radius: r' = max { diam_lambda'(s) : s in rows' }, exact (recomputed over the child's own display)
E-PEEL.honesty: preserved: a restriction of an honest layout is honest

E-PUNCTURE.child_layout: lambda restricted to Q \ {q}: the parent's coordinates read at the surviving qubits
E-PUNCTURE.radius: r' = max { diam_lambda'(s) : s in rows' }, exact (recomputed over the child's own display)
E-PUNCTURE.honesty: preserved: a restriction of an honest layout is honest

E-EXTEND.child_layout: not inherited when Delta is nonempty: a layout lambda' on Q union Delta that agrees with lambda on Q must be supplied; with Delta = {} the layout is lambda itself
E-EXTEND.radius: r' = max(r, max { diam_lambda'(s) : s an added row }), exact, when such a layout is supplied; without one the child has no radius
E-EXTEND.direction: r' >= r (when a layout is supplied)
E-EXTEND.honesty: not inherited: the supplied layout must be honest (conditional cell); with Delta = {} preserved

E-GLUE.child_layout: the two factor layouts blockwise, as for C-DIRECT-SUM; a merged layout must be supplied
E-GLUE.radius: r = max(r_A, r_B, max { diam(s) : s a seam row }), exact (the direct-sum cell followed by one C-ADD-CHECK cell per seam check)
E-GLUE.honesty: not automatic: the merged layout must be honest (conditional cell)

L-HGP.direction: none: no parent to compare with

what_the_semantics_does_not_do: Does not compute exact distance. Conditional deletion and graft prices and exhaustive minimum-weight-class enumerations are consumer judgment inputs, not verified by the state transition.
Does not exhibit a residual. An inapplicable command has no derivation, so nothing says WHERE a sequence got stuck.
Does not read `steps`. No premise and no judgment consults provenance.
Does not quotient by presentation. P-RELABEL is a congruence to be proved, not a built-in equality.

what_the_semantics_does_not_do.note: The evaluator transition (section 4.31, 2026-10-27) defines the state update only. No distance relation is admitted beyond the section 2e/2f conditional cell; the logical-witness and boundary/edge-label fields are defined as future-Pi type sketches (STATE_MODEL.md section 1/1a), and the scalar relation d = min(d_A, d_B) is not admitted.

standing.note: The hand derivations in spec/OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS.md section 4 are evidence in this repository, not kernel-checked results. The soundness metatheorem is OBL-JUDGMENT-SOUNDNESS and is `proved` by hand derivation (spec/OPERATIONAL_SEMANTICS.md section 4.11). A partial mechanization exists under lean/; see lean/README.md for its scope.
standing.conformance: Each entry in fixtures/mvp_fixtures.json is an acceptance test: evaluating `term` on `initial_state` must produce `expected` exactly, or fail exactly as specified - no derivation, no stuck residual, no partial state.
standing.layout_conformance: The layout cells are checked by machine/experiments/layout_conformance_harness.py (randomized states and layouts; every transition transited; directions, formulas, and honesty verdicts compared exactly). Evidence only; it discharges nothing.
